genius.licensingRegulator: BMA (current issuer); OCC granted Agora National Trust Bank preliminary conditional charter approval on 2026-09-18, with final approval and permission to commence business still subject to preopening requirements
genius.notes: OCC Corporate Decision 1393 dated September 18, 2026 grants preliminary conditional approval to Agora National Trust Bank, a proposed affiliate of current AUSD issuer Agora Bermuda Limited. The decision explicitly withholds final approval and authorization to commence business until preopening requirements are met. It describes a future cutover of AUSD reserve assets and liabilities from Agora Bermuda to the Bank after establishment. This is not evidence of completed issuer migration or GENIUS PPSI approval, so issuerEntity and authorizationStatus remain unchanged. The federal-qualified-nonbank pathway describes the announced future uninsured-bank route, not a present authorization of the Bermuda issuer. Agora's September 21 disclosure still says final approval is outstanding. Verified customers can redeem AUSD under the terms; third-party wrappers have no automatic direct Agora redemption entitlement. The monthly attestation flag records the reports publicly listed at Agora's transparency hub, not a finding that all GENIUS reserve requirements are satisfied. No named public GENIUS enforcement action was found in the scoped agency-domain searches.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: The opened OCC decision grants only preliminary conditional bank-charter approval and explicitly defers AUSD issuer cutover. Current Agora terms continue to name Agora Bermuda Limited. No public section 5 GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified authorization or registered foreign-issuer exception naming current AUSD issuer Agora Bermuda Limited was located in the specified sources and exact-name searches as of 2026-10-07. This does not negate the September 18 charter milestone or establish that no issuer anywhere has received approval.
